# ShipDime

ShipDime is a Chrome extension for U.S. online sellers that helps create shipping labels from recipient addresses selected directly on webpages.

Tagline: Select. Right-click. Ship.
Company: Veycell LLC
Website: https://www.shipdime.com

## Current scope

ShipDime currently supports U.S. domestic shipping. Current label types include available USPS Ground Advantage and USPS Priority Mail. Savings and service availability may vary by shipment. If a shipping address is available as selectable text in the browser, the user can explicitly select it to begin the workflow; ShipDime does not claim compatibility with every website.
